{{Quote|You ever hear of Dersonn III? Or the Iti Cluster colonies?''"<br />"''Weren't they destroyed?''"<br />"''Right, that's because Hanharr happened.|Mira and the Jedi Exile|<ref name="KOTOR2" />}}
'''Dersonn III''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="KOTOR2" /> located in the [[Dersonn system/Legends|Dersonn system]], a part of the [[Tammuz sector/Legends|Tammuz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At one point, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Slaver/Legends|enslaver]] [[Hanharr]], who had previously been [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] himself and harbored a hatred for other living beings, particularly [[Human/Legends|Humans]], caused the destruction of the population of Dersonn III. He also survived a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crash on the celestial body, a fact that was witnessed by the Human [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Mira]].<ref name="KOTOR2" />

{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
In [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="3951 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> Mira relayed Hanharr's involvement with Dersonn III to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]], who had previously heard of the destruction of the astronomical object's population.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dersonn III was mentioned in the [[2004]] [[Obsidian Entertainment]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. In the game, the world can be mentioned in an optional conversation the player character, the Jedi Exile, can have with Mira after the former has made a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]&ndash;aligned choice regarding the latter and Hanharr and after Mira has joined their crew as a result. This article assumes one hundred percent game completion&mdash;as well as that the player character makes only light side&ndash;aligned choices&mdash;and that the conversation took place as described.<ref name="KOTOR2" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Dersonn [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Dersonn III, in grid square T-14.<ref name="TEA" />
